title: Dog Potty Tray With Removable Grating, Leak-Proof Indoor Dog Toilet For Puppy Training
body_html:
Product Description

This upgraded mesh dog potty tray is an ideal indoor toilet solution for puppies and small to medium dogs, solving the trouble of paw staining, messy fur and lingering urine odor perfectly.

Extra Large Spacious Size Overall dimension: 65cm50cm (25.619.7 inch). 

The wide platform offers enough room for medium dogs to stand and turn around freely, also suitable for multiple puppies to share. 

Separated Mesh Grid Keep Paws Clean 

The dense hollow mesh surface keeps pets’ paws and belly fur away from urine. Liquid drains directly down to the bottom tray without soaking their coats. The pull-out mesh panel can be taken apart independently for easy deep cleaning. 

Fully Leakproof Deep Basin Base 

Thickened all-in-one plastic tray with raised blue surrounding edges, no gaps to stop liquid leakage and side spills, protecting your floor, carpet and wooden floor from urine damage. Sturdy PP plastic resists biting, cracking and deformation for long-time use. 

Super Easy to Clean & Odor Control 

Split design of mesh and base makes rinsing effortless. You can line the bottom with disposable pee pads or pet litter; just pull out the grid to replace pads in seconds, greatly reducing indoor unpleasant smells. 

Safe & Household Friendly Design

 Smooth rounded corners prevent pets from bumping injuries. Minimalist blue-white matte finish matches all home styles, perfect for bathroom, balcony and living room placement. Great for puppy potty training, apartment indoor dogs, rainy days emergency use when you can’t walk your dogs outside.
